beyondTrading.name: GTA 6 Countdown Hype
beyondTrading.description: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 — roughly 10 weeks out. This is arguably the single biggest shared cultural moment on the calendar right now; countdown content, Vice City/Leonida references, and character-switch mechanics are dominating gaming social media and bleeding into mainstream culture broadly.

beyondTrading.name: General newsjacking opportunity
beyondTrading.description: Massively-trending non-niche moments (a GTA6 launch, a viral sports moment, a major awards show) reliably outperform niche content when a brand ties in fast and authentically — worth having a rapid-response process ready for whatever breaks next, not just trading news.

contentIdeas.title: The $99 to $5 Reveal
contentIdeas.hookLine: Wait... the activation fee is HOW much now?
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Lead with the number, not the explanation. Let curiosity carry the first 3 seconds before revealing the full pricing change.

contentIdeas.title: We Got Denied a Payout (On Purpose) — Here's What We Learned
contentIdeas.hookLine: We deliberately broke a rule to show you exactly what happens.
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Radical transparency angle — walk through a real rule violation and the resulting payout denial to build trust through honesty.

contentIdeas.title: DT-Bucks Countdown Series
contentIdeas.hookLine: You're 12 trading days away from a free account.
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Turn the reward program into a weekly countdown series traders want to follow — gamified progress, not just a feature explainer.

contentIdeas.title: Prop Firm Rules, Debunked
contentIdeas.hookLine: 5 things traders get wrong about drawdown rules (thread)
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Myth vs. reality format, one misconception per tweet, ending with a clear call to check your own account's actual rule.

contentIdeas.title: Bring a Trader, Earn DT-Bucks
contentIdeas.hookLine: Your friend's first payout just paid for your next account.
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Frame the affiliate program as a story (a real referral's payout) rather than a generic "refer a friend" pitch.

contentIdeas.title: Leonida Loadout: If GTA 6 Characters Traded Futures
contentIdeas.hookLine: Jason and Lucia open a DayTraders account before the heist.
contentIdeas.keyMessaging: Riffs on the GTA 6 Nov 19 launch hype (Vice City/Leonida aesthetic, character-switch mechanic) without using any copyrighted footage — original animation/live-action styled after the vibe, not a reproduction of Rockstar's actual game or characters.
contentIdeas.note: IMPORTANT: do not use actual GTA 6 footage, character likenesses, or music — that's Rockstar/Take-Two's copyrighted IP. This should be an original piece merely inspired by the launch-hype moment, similar to how outlets do "if it were a trading firm" style parodies of unrelated pop culture.
